title: prep-worktree: copy primary reference-impl/dist into spawned worktree
definition_of_done: `prepWorktree()` in `reference-impl/lib/prep-worktree.ts` calls `primeCopy(join(resolvedMain, 'reference-impl', 'dist'), join(worktreePath, 'reference-impl', 'dist'))` immediately after the existing `reference-impl/node_modules` copy step.

A regression test case is added to `reference-impl/tests/prep-worktree.test.ts` that asserts `<worktree>/reference-impl/dist/` exists and contains at least one `.mjs` file after `prepWorktree()` runs against a fixture primary repo.
All pre-existing tests in `reference-impl/tests/` continue to pass.
acceptance_criteria: Given a primary repo whose `reference-impl/dist/` contains `.mjs` files, after `prepWorktree()` completes the spawned worktree's `reference-impl/dist/` exists and contains those same `.mjs` files.
Running `prepWorktree()` a second time on the same worktree is idempotent: `primeCopy` wipes and re-copies without error.
A Reviewer or QA agent importing from `<worktree>/reference-impl/dist/lib/qa-report.js` (or any other dist entry) does not encounter a `Cannot find module` error after `prepWorktree()` completes.
No new build step (`npm run build`) is invoked inside the worktree's `reference-impl/` — the copy of primary's already-built dist is used directly.
